tips.text: Run `npm run doctor` whenever something seems off. It checks every hub component and says how to fix what it finds.
Run `npm run self-check -- builder` for a short readiness report on one agent: its profile, skills and memory.
Run `npm run version:check` to see whether a newer hub release is available.
Run `npm run list` to see every project's todo, in-flight and done tasks in one view.
Run `npm run install-skill -- <name>` to add an optional skill to your hub, for example `frontend-design`.
Run `npm.cmd run check:tickets -- --hub-root .` to catch task files whose state no longer matches their GitHub issue.
Run `npm run memory-index:build`, then search your agents' memory by keyword with `npm run memory-index -- find <keyword>`.
